name: sensei_recall_handled_in_flow
description: Recall dispatched with when/else in a flow stage compiles cleanly
input:
use
  llm.reason

task answer_question
  needs question: Text, context: Text
  gives Text
  do
    result = reason "Answer: {question} using {context}"
    when result.sure -> give result
    else -> give "Unknown"

flow answer_query
  needs question: Text
  gives Text

  stage retrieve
    prior = recall "{question}"

  stage respond
    needs retrieve.prior
    prior = retrieve.prior
    when prior.sure -> give answer_question(question, prior)
    when prior.unsure -> give answer_question(question, prior)
    else -> give "No knowledge found."
